name: Liuguanghe Bridge
facts: Liuguanghe Bridge, soaring 297 metres high, held the world’s highest bridge title from 2001 until 2003, eclipsing the 72‑year‑old Royal Gorge Bridge in the United States.
The bridge’s 240‑metre span rests on a 90‑metre pillar perched at the edge of a steep, deep valley, showcasing remarkable beam‑bridge engineering.
Despite newer, taller bridges, Liuguanghe remains the highest beam bridge worldwide and ranks among the world’s top twenty tallest bridges as of 2011.
